subject.title: feat: inspect background tasks across web and mobile

question: Should every `operator.read` client be allowed to enumerate task IDs and retrieve the bounded user prompt through `tasks.get`?
rationale: The change intentionally exposes task input that may contain sensitive user text through an established read-level permission, and tests cannot determine whether that is the intended permanent authorization boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded prompt access
options.body: Confirm that `operator.read` includes task input, retain lookup-only delivery, document the sensitivity, and require tests proving list responses and events remain prompt-free.

options.title: Narrow the permission boundary
options.body: Require a stronger scope or a separately approved capability before `tasks.get` returns prompt text.

options.title: Omit prompt exposure
options.body: Ship cross-client task history and output inspection without returning the original task prompt.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded prompt access
recommendation.body: Confirm that `operator.read` includes task input, retain lookup-only delivery, document the sensitivity, and require tests proving list responses and events remain prompt-free.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the public SDK surface and own the cross-client direction represented by this branch.
